name: Haus
short_desc: Meters, shared costs, tasks and wiki for a building shared by a few households.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Server for the Haus apps (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows) and the web app it serves at its own address: meter readings, the Betriebskosten split and yearly statement, tasks, appointments, equipment and a wiki. Open the app's domain in a browser, or enter it in one of the apps.

form_fields.label: Pairing page password
form_fields.hint: Optional. Turns on https://<domain>/pair, which shows the current pairing codes with a QR code, behind this password (any user name). Empty: no page.

form_fields.label: Pairing page from outside the home network
form_fields.hint: Off: the pairing page answers home-network addresses only.

form_fields.label: CITIES login (e-mail or phone)
form_fields.hint: Optional. Your CITIES app login, for the waste calendar (Abfuhrkalender). Read only by the server; never logged or exported.

form_fields.label: CITIES password
form_fields.hint: Optional. The password of that CITIES login.
